1. a heap , Lat. acervus, (Hesiod), etc. 
2. generally, a heap, quantity , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

1. a band, riband, fillet , especially a head-band , worn in sign of victory, (Xenophon Historicus), etc. 
2. a strip or tongue of land , (Plutarch), etc. (ML)

fit for ordering or arranging , especially in war, τ. ἀνήρ a tactician , (Xenophon Historicus); τακτικὸν ἡγεῖσθαί τι to think it a good piece of tactics , (Xenophon Historicus); οἱ τ. ἀριθμοί the regular battalions, (Xenophon Historicus): τὰ τακτικά the art of drawing up soldiers in array, tactics , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

suffering, wretched , Lat. miser, (Odyssey by Homer); ὦ τάλαιν᾽ ἐγώ (Aeschulus Tragicus); ὦ τάλαν (Sophocles Tragicus);—;with genitive causae, τάλαιν᾽ ἐγὼ τῆς ὕβρεως wretched that I am for this insolence, (Aristophanes Comicus):—;in bad sense, τάλαν wretch! (Odyssey by Homer)—;comparative τᾶλάντερος, η, ον: Sup. τᾶλάντατος, η, ον, (Aristophanes Comicus) 
τᾶλα_; doric also τᾶλᾶς: vocative τάλᾶν. (ML)

1. one who carves and distributes, a dispenser , (Iliad by Homer):—;of Zeus, as the dispenser of all things to men, (Iliad by Homer); so Aeolus is τ. ἀνέμων (Odyssey by Homer):—;of kings or rulers, a controller, director , (Pindar); τ. κώμων master of the revels, (Pindar); τ. Διός the priest of Zeus, (Pindar): τ. Μοισᾶν, i. e. a poet, (Pindar); οἶκος τ. στεφάνων that hath store of crowns, (Pindar); τῆς τε ἐπιθυμίας…

1. to be controller of receipts and expenditure, to be treasurer, paymaster , (Aristophanes Comicus):—;with genitive, τ. τῆς Παράλου to be paymaster of the Paralus, (Demosthenes Orator) 
2. at Rome, to be quaestor , (Plutarch) 
3. transitive to deal out, dispense , (Plato Philosophus), etc.:—;Pass., τοὺς νόμους τεταμιεύμεθα we have the laws dealt out , (Lysias Orator):—;Mid., ταμιεύεσθαι εἰς ὅσον βουλόμεθα ἄρχειν to…
